items.en: The Federation of Engine Remanufacturers (FER) has concluded its 2026 Conference and Annual General Meeting at the Hilton Hotel in Cambridge, bringing together key stakeholders from across the automotive aftermarket.
The event featured technical presentations from industry experts:
- Julian Thompson (Hartech) shared updates from the independent Porsche specialist.
- Lubricant analyst Lake Speed Jr presented findings on ZDDP additives and engine break-in oils.
- Nino Maglia delivered insights on pistons, cylinder bores, and sliding surfaces.
The proceedings culminated in the FER AGM to discuss the federation’s strategic direction.

Rod Bennett, operations manager at FER, commented: “As we adapt to modern demands, events like these are crucial to our strategy. I’m delighted with the great turnout as we look ahead to the future of engine maintenance.”

Bridgestone UK is leveraging Tyre Safety Month 2026 to highlight a striking disconnect between driver attitudes and actual tyre maintenance, citing fresh research commissioned through Research Without Barriers (surveying 2,000 UK car owners in January 2026).
